svg.title: C30 conceptual research model
svg.desc: ARTEMIS FIRST HORIZONS: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: Which combination of seed mass distribution, accretion duty cycle, radiative efficiency, and
merger history can explain observed early black holes without violating survey selection and
Halo/galaxy/SMBH statistical constraints, redshift-dependent population products
L_{\rm Edd}=4\pi GMm_pc/\sigma_T;\quad L=\lambda L_{\rm Edd}
Recover known seed-mixture parameters from blind synthetic selected populations.
Conceptual design • proposed research • full equations, data access and uncertainty in the dossier
